scripts.test-off: npm run test-lab-lint && npm run test-mocha
scripts.test-lab: lab -v -P test -t 0 -r console -o stdout -r html -o test/coverage.html
scripts.test-lab-lint: lab -v -P test -t 0 -L -r console -o stdout -r html -o test/coverage.html
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm test
scripts.repo-check: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: v$REPO_VERSION && [[ '' == `git tag --list v${REPO_VERSION}` ]]
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag v$REPO_VERSION && git push --tags;
scripts.repo-version:dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path='./package.json'; const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8')); const match=/^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(-.+)?$/.exec(pkg.version); if(!match){ throw new Error('Unsupported version format: '+pkg.version); } pkg.version=[match[1],match[2],String(Number(match[3])+5)].join('.')+(match[4]||''); fs.writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2)+'\n'); console.log(pkg.version);"
scripts.repo-tag:dev: git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/develop && git tag -fa dev refs/heads/develop -m "Stable dev tag from refs/heads/develop"
scripts.repo-tag:production: git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/prod && git tag -fa production refs/heads/prod -m "Stable production tag from refs/heads/prod"
scripts.repo-npm-tag:dev: PACKAGE_NAME=`node -p "require('./package.json').name"` && PACKAGE_VERSION=`node -p "require('./package.json').version"` && if npm view "$PACKAGE_NAME@$PACKAGE_VERSION" version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm dist-tag add "$PACKAGE_NAME@$PACKAGE_VERSION" dev --registry https://registry.npmjs.org; else npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --tag dev --access=public; fi
scripts.repo-npm-tag:production: PACKAGE_NAME=`node -p "require('./package.json').name"` && PACKAGE_VERSION=`node -p "require('./package.json').version"` && if npm view "$PACKAGE_NAME@$PACKAGE_VERSION" version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm dist-tag add "$PACKAGE_NAME@$PACKAGE_VERSION" prd --registry https://registry.npmjs.org; else npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --tag prd --access=public; fi
scripts.repo-publish: npm run repo-check && npm run clean && npm i --registry https://registry.npmjs.org && npm run prettier && npm run vue-build  && npm run repo-tag && npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
scripts.repo-publish-quick: npm run repo-check && npm run prettier && npm run vue-build && npm run repo-tag && npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --access=public
scripts.repo-publish:dev: npm run repo-version:dev && npm run vue-build && npm run repo-tag:dev && git push origin refs/tags/dev --force && npm run repo-npm-tag:dev
scripts.repo-publish:production: npm run vue-build && npm run repo-tag:production && git push origin refs/tags/production --force && npm run repo-npm-tag:production
